title_zh: 人工智能与工作的未来
title_en: Visions of the Future (16/20): AI and the Future of Work
note_en: 不管 + a question word means "no matter…" or "whatever…": 不管未来到底会怎样 "whatever the future actually holds." English turns the question word into "whatever/however," but Chinese simply keeps the question (怎样 "how") after 不管, often adding 到底 for emphasis. The main clause that follows states what stays true in every case — here, 一个不可否认的事实是… "one fact is undeniable."
